The '''Small Wall Pumpkin''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall.  It can be won in the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|fall}}.

Note that the Small Wall Pumpkin hangs lower on the wall than the [[Wall Pumpkin]].
